name: Familiar Friend

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepared: Find Familiar; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for casting. Once per Long Rest, cast Find Familiar without a slot or Material components. This special casting is reference-only. When casting Find Familiar, increase its current and maximum Hit Points by twice your character level. While your familiar is within 5 feet, gain Advantage on a proficient skill check. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
